# Header author documentation and implementation must be checked separately

The shared trait documents author as From with Sender fallback, but its current mail_parser implementation reads self.to().or(self.sender()). The historical EWS trait already had this mismatch before 1266, so borrowing did not introduce it. A scoped review check is to compare the named header contract with the method actually called. No active caller of populate_from_message_headers was found in the bounded current Rust search; no wrong-sender runtime result or root-cause attribution is claimed. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: rust/protocol_shared/src.
